name: simple_created_by
query:
find Artist, Work
where
  created_by(Work, Artist)

name: constant_binding
query:
find Work
where
  created_by(Work, judith_goddard)

name: join_exhibited
query:
find Artist, Work, Gallery
where
  person(Artist)
  created_by(Work, Artist)
  exhibited_at(Work, Gallery)

name: range_year_ge_1970
query:
find Artist, Work, Y
where
  created_by(Work, Artist)
  year_created(Work, Y)
  Y >= 1970

name: range_year_between
query:
find Artist, Work, Y
where
  created_by(Work, Artist)
  year_created(Work, Y)
  Y between 1975 and 1980

name: range_integer
query:
find Work, M
where
  duration_minutes(Work, M)
  M > 10

name: optional_order
query:
find Artist, Work
where
  person(Artist)
  interviewed_artist(Artist)
  optional
    created_by(Work, Artist)
order by Artist ascending

name: negation
query:
find Artist
where
  interviewed_artist(Artist)
  not
    funded_by(Artist, arts_council)

name: invalid_unsafe_negation
query:
find Artist
where
  interviewed_artist(Artist)
  not
    funded_by(Artist, F)

name: invalid_unknown_predicate
query:
find W
where
  created_bi(W, A)

name: invalid_syntax
query: find W where created_by(W, A)

name: paged_has_more
query:
find Work
where
  created_by(Work, A)
order by Work ascending
limit 5
offset 2

name: empty_misspelled
query:
find Work
where
  created_by(Work, david_critchly)

name: empty_comparison
query:
find Work
where
  year_created(Work, Y)
  Y > @2090

name: count_per_artist
query:
find Artist, count(Work)
where
  created_by(Work, Artist)
order by count(Work) descending, Artist ascending
limit 5

name: count_overall
query:
find count(Work), count(Artist)
where
  created_by(Work, Artist)

name: count_zero_explained
query:
find count(Work)
where
  created_by(Work, david_critchly)

name: invalid_count
query:
find Artist, count(Artist)
where
  created_by(Work, Artist)

name: contains_string
query:
find Exhibition, Title
where
  exhibition_title(Exhibition, Title)
  Title contains "VIDEO"

name: contains_atom_count
query:
find Artist, count(Work)
where
  created_by(Work, Artist)
  Work contains "tape"
order by count(Work) descending, Artist ascending

name: contains_empty_explained
query:
find Work
where
  created_by(Work, Artist)
  Work contains "zzqx"

name: invalid_contains
query:
find Work
where
  year_created(Work, Y)
  Y contains "19"

name: invalid_type_mismatch
query:
find W
where
  year_created(W, Y)
  Y >= @1970-01-01
